performance.verdict: Spend collapse is a delivery failure, not a creative one — milestones still unbuilt.

findings.text: 7 of 10 SOW milestones are overdue by 31–62 days: stack test, GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta account/CAPI, landing pages, search campaigns, and Phase 1 close still incomplete as of 2026-10-01.

CPL spiked 50.14% in 7d while spend fell 56.11%; 3-day spend recovery (Sep 28–30: $33.90, $52.76, $49.88) is rebuilding but leads (4, 6, 9) lag, yielding ~$5.54 CPL vs $3.28 CPL in the peak Sep 19–21 window.
Sep 22–24 delivered $0 spend across 3 consecutive days, likely a budget exhaustion or account-level pause; GBP actions also dropped to 0 on Sep 29–30, compounding organic signal loss.
GA4 sessions collapsed 66.8% week-over-week, dropping to 14–19 sessions/day Sep 24–25, consistent with the spend blackout — organic baseline appears thin without paid traffic.

GBP generated 62 actions (11 calls, 33 directions) over 28 days from 161 impressions at MedStation Weston — a 6.83% call rate — but GHL pipeline is null, so arrival-to-opportunity conversion is unverifiable.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 7 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer and Sohib immediately; no paid scale is defensible without stack test and tracking live.
suggestions.monday_update: Seven SOW milestones are 31–62 days overdue, including the pre-launch stack test (due Jul 31), Meta CAPI, landing pages, and the Phase 1 close conversation (due Sep 30). No paid budget increases should be approved until the end-to-end stack test confirms lead → GHL → EHR tracking is intact. Escalate to Nacer (Ops) and Sohib (Account) by 2026-10-03 and get gate sign-off logged. Success check: stack test marked complete in Monday by 2026-10-08.

suggestions.text: Monitor 3-day CPL on MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP; if CPL holds ≤$5.56 (28d avg) through Oct 4, then consider a ≤20% budget increase.
suggestions.monday_update: Spend recovered to $49.88 on Sep 30 after a 3-day $0 blackout, but CPL is running above the 28-day average of $5.56. Do not scale budget until 3 consecutive days confirm CPL at or below $5.56 and lead volume is trending up (current 3-day run: 4, 6, 9). Re-check on 2026-10-04. If CPL holds, bring a ≤20% daily budget increase to Sohib for approval.

suggestions.text: Verify GHL pipeline is receiving inbound leads; GHL data is null despite 114 leads in 28 days — intake leak must be ruled out before scaling.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL pipeline data returned null this cycle despite 114 Meta leads recorded over 28 days. This means we cannot confirm whether leads are reaching the intake team or converting to booked appointments — the primary Phase 1 success metric. Ops (Nacer) should pull a manual GHL count of new contacts created since Sep 1 and compare to the 114 Meta leads. Success check: GHL contact count reconciled and reported by 2026-10-05.
